# The files this fork owns.
#
# An upstream merge can only ever take a file away, never rewrite one: every path listed here is
# absent from upstream, so if it is still there after the merge the fork kept it, and if it is
# gone the merge dropped something the user of this app depends on.
#
# The list is what a merge is checked against before a release is built, so a lost file fails the
# sync rather than reaching a phone. Generated by tools/make_fork_manifest.py.
